title: SAFEWATCH: AN EFFICIENT SAFETY-POLICY FOLLOWING VIDEO GUARDRAIL MODEL WITH TRANSPARENT EXPLANATIONS
reasoning: The paper develops a video safety guardrail model and a benchmark (SAFEWATCH-BENCH) to evaluate content safety across ethical and moral categories such as 'Hateful Content & Extremism' and 'Illegal/Regulated Activities'. Notably, in the policy guidelines section of the appendix (page 36), it explicitly defines and evaluates categories for 'RELIGION', including the respectful treatment of religious practices, symbols, and rituals, which constitutes a benchmarked component for religious and ethical values.
